intro: The Runes of Summoning are a ritual item provided by the warlock trainer Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. They are used to call forth an unbound voidwalker into a summoning circle so that an aspiring warlock may bend it to their will.

p: Within the dark recesses of the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Forsaken practitioners of the dark arts study the manipulation of the Nether. Carendin Halgar entrusts the Runes of Summoning only to warlocks who have prepared themselves to take command of a voidwalker. By casting the runes within the active summoning circle below Halgar's station, the practitioner tears through the fabric of the Void, drawing forth a creature that must be overpowered and bound into servitude.
